'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy]] seizes two vessels after attempting to cross the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. A third vessel is also reportedly "disabled off Iran's coast". [https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/22/world/live-news/iran-war-us-trump-blockade-ceasefire?post-id=cmo9wicq300013b6pj5jq1icc (CNN)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on the Kurdistan Region]]
****Three members of the [[Kurdistan Freedom Party]] are injured in a [[drone warfare|drone attack]] in the [[Khabat District]], [[Kurdistan Region]], [[Iraq]]. The group attributes the attack to Iran. [https://aje.news/70fs10?update=4512809 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[April 2026 attack on French UNIFIL peacekeepers in Lebanon]]
****A [[French Armed Forces|French]] [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UNIFIL]] [[peacekeeping|peacekeeper]] dies from his wounds sustained from an ambush last week blamed on [[Hezbollah]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2026/04/22/second-french-peacekeeper-dies-after-ambush-blamed-on-hezbollah-macron-says (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
***[[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s kill at least five people across [[Lebanon]], including [[Al Akhbar (Lebanon)|''Al Akhbar'']] journalist [[Amal Khalil]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/22/at-least-four-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-lebanon-journalists-wounded (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Suspected [[Boko Haram]] insurgents on [[motorcycle]]s kill at least 20 people in shootings in [[Borno State]] and [[Adamawa State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-boko-haram-militants-kill-20-northeast-nigeria-attacks-2026-04-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Ten people are killed and eight others are injured in an attack on a [[Mining in Pakistan|copper and gold mine]] in [[Chagai District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. A [[Turkey|Turkish]] citizen is among the fatalities, while another is kidnapped. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2026/04/23/turkish-national-among-10-killed-in-pakistan-mining-project-attack- (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***[[Germany|German]] [[airline]] [[Lufthansa]] announces that it will cut 20,000 [[Flight length|short-haul flights]] in [[Europe]] this summer, saying rising [[jet fuel|fuel]] prices have made many flights "unprofitable" for the company. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cre1r4n5j5wo (BBC News)]
**[[Stock market|Stocks]] in the [[United States]], including [[S&P 500]] and [[Nasdaq]], rise following yesterday’s announcement that the [[2026 Iran war ceasefire|ceasefire]] would be extended indefinitely. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2026/04/21/stock-market-today-live-updates.html (CNBC)]
*[[Germany–Russia relations]], [[Russia in the European energy sector]]
**[[Russia]] announces it will halt the transport of [[Oil and gas basins of Kazakhstan|Kazakh oil]] to [[Germany]] via the [[Druzhba pipeline]] starting May 1, citing technical reasons, while the [[Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy|German economic ministry]] states that the interruption is not expected to significantly disrupt [[Energy in Germany|fuel supply]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260422-russia-to-block-flow-of-kazakh-oil-to-german-refinery-berlin-says (AFP via France 24)]

*[[2026 Institute, West Virginia chemical disaster]]
**A leak results in a violent [[chemical reaction]] involving [[nitric acid]] and another substance at a facility in [[Kanawha County, West Virginia|Kanawha County]], [[West Virginia]], United States, killing two people and injuring 19 others. [https://apnews.com/article/west-virginia-chemical-leak-aa346adfcb6fecaad91f189b676c06bb (AP)]
*Eleven people are killed, including children, in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] in [[Mirzapur]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.deccanherald.com/india/uttar-pradesh/11-killed-in-multi-vehicle-crash-in-uttar-pradeshs-mirzapur-3977478 (PTI via ''Deccan Herald'')]

[https://turquesanews.mx/mexico/choque-de-autobus-en-queretaro-deja-tres-pasajeros-fallecidos-y-al-menos-20-lesionados/ (Turquesa News <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*Two people are killed and 16 others are injured when a passenger bus carrying [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] citizens strikes a group of people and crashes into a ditch in [[Burgas]], [[Bulgaria]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/04/22/8031266/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war]]
***[[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]], remains on [[lockdown]] ahead of a potential, unconfirmed second round of [[Islamabad Talks|talks between Iran and the U.S. in the city]]. [https://www.digitaljournal.com/world/pakistans-capital-holds-its-breath-with-us-iran-talks-in-limbo/article (''Digital Journal'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Moldova]]
**[[Moldova]]n oligarch and former politician [[Vladimir Plahotniuc]] is sentenced to 19 years in prison for [[Embezzlement|embezzling]] about [[United States dollar|US$]]1 billion from [[List of banks in Moldova|the country's banks]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldovan-court-sentences-tycoon-plahotniuc-19-years-fraud-case-2026-04-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in the Philippines]]
**[[International Criminal Court]] (ICC) judges dismiss former [[President of the Philippines|Philippine president]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]]'s jurisdictional challenge regarding the ICC's authority over alleged crimes committed while the [[Philippines]] was still a member, allowing proceedings to continue against Duterte on charges of [[crimes against humanity]] linked to [[Philippine drug war|his anti-drug campaign]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/icc-judges-reject-bid-release-former-philippines-president-duterte-2026-04-22/ (Reuters)]
